name: Super Algator Bros
storyline:
Algator's adventure begins when Harleen is mysteriously trapped on another Discord server by the Rabbids. Determined to rescue her, Algator sets off across eight dangerous worlds filled with enemies, traps, platforms, caves, and hidden surprises.

Along the way, he must collect likes, discover powerful transformations, eat magical crêpes, activate MODE R9, and overcome increasingly difficult challenges. His journey eventually leads him to two powerful bosses standing between him and Harleen's freedom.

To save her and restore peace to the Discord universe, Algator must reach the end of every world, defeat his enemies, and prove that he is the ultimate Algator Bros. hero.
summary:
Super Algator Bros. is a fast-paced 2D platformer following Algator on a chaotic adventure across eight unique worlds. After the Rabbids trap Harleen on another Discord server, Algator must travel through dangerous environments, collect likes, eat crêpes, defeat enemies, and unlock powerful transformations to rescue her.

Jump across platforms, break blocks, collect rewards, dodge traps, and take on enemies such as Rabbits, Hog Riders, and flying Canaries. Throughout the adventure, Algator can obtain special power-ups including the Crêpe transformation, the powerful MODE R9, and a temporary GOAT power that makes him nearly unstoppable.

The game features a mix of classic platforming challenges, moving platforms, caves, speedrun-style sections, castles, and boss arenas. Players must defeat two major bosses before reaching the final goal and freeing Harleen.

With its pixel-art presentation, original chiptune soundtrack, humorous internet-inspired universe, and arcade-style gameplay, Super Algator Bros. combines classic 2D platforming with the characters, references, and chaotic style of the Algator universe.
